name: Courier

evidence.transactional: F02: transactional email and product notifications, sent through your own email provider (F03)
evidence.newsletter: F02: newsletter and announcement broadcasts to lists or audiences
evidence.marketing: F02: lifecycle sequences such as onboarding, re-engagement and digests
evidence.multichannel: F06: one template can reach email, SMS and push in one send, and counts once

line: Route email notifications and build broadcasts and lifecycle journeys.

subs.math: 4,000 sends a month fit inside the 10,000 free sends each month. Fees from your email provider are extra.
20,000 sends a month at $0.005 each = $100 a month. Fees from your email provider are extra.
40,000 sends a month at $0.005 each = $200 a month. Fees from your email provider are extra.
200,000 sends a month at $0.005 each = $1,000 a month. Fees from your email provider are extra.

appmail.math: 3,000 sends a month fit the Developer plan. Charges from your production email provider are extra.
10,000 sends a month fit inside the Developer plan's free monthly cap.
50,000 sends a month at $0.005 each = $250 a month. Charges from your production email provider are extra.
100,000 sends a month at $0.005 each = $500 a month. Charges from your production email provider are extra.
